race.comment: GAMBLER'S GOLD (5) wasn't far behind them in a good race at Broome last time out, with that performance setting him up nicely for this. Gray's booking is a big push for his chances here and he rates highly on that latest effort. He'll prove hard to hold out with a touch of luck early on. DYNAMIC ONE (2) bounced back last start at 2050m here with a 1.4L defeat as the race favourite. The wide draw is a niggle, though he does possess some good early speed and if he can get across early in the race, he'll be in this for a very long way. ZADAR ROCK (1) beat DYNAMIC ONE two back before winning the Roebourne Cup last time out in impressive fashion. Carries the big weight here but he deserves it with his recent form and he can secure the hat-trick. HAFEY (6) can improve quickly coming to this trip with Faithfull booked. LUTZ (8) is next best off a good last start effort at Derby.
